boards.title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Chico, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative Friday-to-Sunday sequence mixing campus orientation, student recreation, art, local history, science, and nearby outdoor spaces.

cards.title: Friday: Meet the Creek
cards.subtitle: Begin with the waterway crossing campus
cards.notes: Walk between the campus footbridges, watch for wildlife, and stay off the fragile creek bank to avoid worsening erosion.
cards.short_summary: Start the weekend by learning the natural feature that divides and defines the campus landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State states that Big Chico Creek flows through campus, supports trout, salmon, and river otters, and has fragile banks visitors should avoid trampling.
cards.source_title: Big Chico Creek – Sustainability at Chico State
cards.access_notes: Remain on established campus paths and bridges; the university specifically asks visitors to step away from the creek bank.

cards.title: Friday: Read the Campus Through Its Trees
cards.subtitle: Continue across the university’s 132-acre arboretum
cards.notes: Choose a self-guided walk through campus and compare tree forms as you move toward the arts buildings and downtown edge.
cards.short_summary: Turn an introductory campus walk into a close look at Chico State’s unusually diverse tree collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State documents that its arboretum encompasses the entire 132-acre campus, contains more than 200 plant species, and has self-guided walks.
cards.access_notes: Use established campus walkways; tour timing and route availability may vary.

cards.title: Friday: Look Closely at Prints
cards.subtitle: Pause in Arts and Humanities, Room 123
cards.notes: Arrive before the Friday closing time, scan the current exhibition first, then return to one print that rewards a longer look.
cards.short_summary: Use a compact campus museum to shift the afternoon from orientation into focused visual attention.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official visit page places it in Arts and Humanities Room 123 and lists academic-year hours Tuesday–Saturday, noon–4 p.m.; Chico State states admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Annual Student Exhibitions Now On View! – Chico State
cards.access_notes: Open during the academic year Tuesday–Saturday, noon–4 p.m.; closed during university breaks. Check the exhibition calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Friday: Finish With Movement
cards.subtitle: Close the first day at the WREC
cards.notes: Bring your Wildcat ID, check in at the desk, and pick one familiar activity while you learn the building’s layout.
cards.short_summary: End Friday with an active stop in a central student facility rather than adding another sightseeing lap.
cards.evidence_claim: The official WREC page lists courts, aquatics, climbing, fitness programming, and semester Friday hours of 7 a.m.–9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Wildcat Recreation Center – Associated Students of CSU, Chico
cards.access_notes: Semester Friday hours are 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Access depends on current membership or guest eligibility; verify the operational notice and bring required identification.

cards.entity_name: Chico Certified Farmers Market – Chico Saturday
cards.title: Saturday: Start at the Market
cards.subtitle: Begin downtown at Second and Wall streets
cards.notes: Walk the full vendor loop before deciding whether to buy anything, and use the morning stop to learn the downtown street grid.
cards.short_summary: Anchor Saturday morning at a recurring, map-specific community activity beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The California Department of Food and Agriculture’s April 2026 market list identifies Chico Saturday at Second and Wall streets as a year-round Saturday market from 7:30 a.m.–1 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed for Saturdays, 7:30 a.m.–1 p.m., year-round. Vendor attendance and weather conditions can vary.

cards.title: Saturday: Add Local Context
cards.subtitle: Cross into the Carnegie library building
cards.notes: Start with the Mechoopda display, then choose one additional gallery that connects the city’s history to places you have walked.
cards.short_summary: Give the campus-and-downtown route historical context through a museum immediately beside the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official page says it occupies the historic Andrew Carnegie Library beside campus and includes permanent displays on the Mechoopda, the Bidwells, and Chico’s natural history.
cards.access_notes: Open Thursday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Monday–Wednesday. The museum lists suggested admission amounts, including a student rate.

cards.title: Saturday: Try Hands-On Science
cards.subtitle: Continue north to 625 Esplanade
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition list, begin indoors, and save time for the garden’s native and edible plant displays.
cards.short_summary: Connect regional science exhibits with a living garden near the northern edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State locates Gateway Science Museum at 625 Esplanade, lists Thursday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–4 p.m., and describes interactive exhibits and permanent garden exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Thursday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Check current exhibitions and admission information before leaving campus.

cards.title: Saturday: Compare California Habitats
cards.subtitle: Step into the museum’s outdoor garden exhibits
cards.notes: Follow the habitat sequence, read the seasonal chalkboards, and look for wildlife without touching plants or leaving paths.
cards.short_summary: Slow the afternoon down with native plants, pollinator habitat, student projects, and outdoor art.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State describes Gateway Gardens as an immersive native-plant exhibit with nearly 200 species, an edible garden, wildlife habitat, murals, and seasonal learning signs.
cards.source_title: Gateway Gardens – Gateway Science Museum – Chico State
cards.access_notes: The official page does not publish separate garden hours or independent admission terms; confirm access with Gateway Science Museum.

cards.title: Sunday: Roll or Observe
cards.subtitle: Visit the expanded park at 371 Humboldt Avenue
cards.notes: Bring appropriate protective gear if skating; otherwise watch from a safe edge and keep bowls and approach lines clear.
cards.short_summary: Add a community recreation stop with concrete street features and a larger bowl.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico Area Recreation and Park District identifies the skate park at 371 Humboldt Avenue and documents an expansion with a larger bowl and street features.
cards.source_title: Humboldt Avenue Skate Park – Chico Area Recreation & Park District
cards.access_notes: Check the official page for temporary maintenance or graffiti-related closures before visiting; skate within your ability and use protective equipment.

cards.entity_name: Valene L. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.title: Sunday Option: Explore Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Use this stop on the month’s first Saturday instead
cards.notes: If your weekend includes the first Saturday, enter from Meriam Library and let one current exhibition guide the final hour.
cards.short_summary: Keep a calendar-aware museum option for a first weekend that lands on the first Saturday of the month.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official page locates it in Meriam Library Room 180, states admission is free, and lists first-Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–3 p.m.
cards.source_title: Valene L. Smith Museum of Anthropology – Chico State
cards.access_notes: Closed Sunday and Monday; normally open Tuesday–Friday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., plus the first Saturday of each month from 11 a.m.–3 p.m.
